pages.brief: Olive the plum-coloured owl perched beside a half-built, sparse twig nest high in a tree, looking at the gaps in it.
Olive the owl flying through the air holding a single thin brown twig in her beak.
Olive the owl carefully weaving a brown twig into the side of her nest, which is already looking fuller.
Olive the owl tucking a soft green leaf and a tuft of moss into the lining of her nest.
Olive the owl stepping back to look at her now round, cosy, finished twig nest.
Olive the owl curled up snugly inside her finished nest at dusk, eyes closed, content.
